Hyphenation under pressure

Resize the window horizontally. Each pane has the same source, type size, and measure.

1 · Deterministic consecutive-hyphen stress case

Go abcdefghijklmnop­qr abcdefghijklm ab­cd abcdefghijklm ef­gh abcdefghijklm ij­kl.

The artificial twelve-letter words make the web optimum continue a visible hyphen chain. Book mode interrupts it after two lines; the emergency path remains available if interruption is impossible.

2 · Paragraph ending

Typographers reconsider every opportunity because an unnecessary penultimate hyphen makes the paragraph ending feel unsettled and mechanical.

Book mode strongly discourages a hyphen immediately before the final line and lets paragraph-wide optimization choose another route.

3 · Natural prose and short fragments

International organizations characteristically institutionalize responsibilities. Away across America, ideas about typography arise amid adaptable arrangements and unusually asymmetric architecture.

Automatically generated points that leave fewer than two characters on either side are removed in book mode. Authored soft hyphens remain authoritative.
